grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity before processing your Sure Start Maternity Grant application

grants.description: Check your current benefit entitlements with DWP
grants.purpose: To verify you are receiving a qualifying benefit (Universal Credit, Income Support, JSA, ESA, Pension Credit, or SMI loan) required for eligibility

grants.description: Provide evidence of pregnancy or childbirth from a health professional
grants.purpose: To confirm the pregnancy or birth and verify timing of claim. This is provided via MAT B1 form or health professional statement

grants.description: Share details about children under 16 in your household
grants.purpose: To determine if this is your first child or if you qualify under special circumstances (twins, triplets, etc.)

grants.description: Share additional information if applying under special circumstances
grants.purpose: To assess eligibility if you have refugee status, are adopting, using surrogacy, or claiming for a family member

revocation.mechanism: Contact DWP Sure Start Maternity Grant helpline on 0800 169 0140 or write to Freepost DWP SSMG
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before decision is made. You will need to reapply with fresh consent if you wish to claim the grant later (within deadline)

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot obtain or submit MAT B1 form on your behalf - this must come from your doctor or midwife. Agent cannot change your benefit claims. Agent cannot provide false information about your household composition or special circumstances. Agent cannot appeal a decision on your behalf - you must request mandatory reconsideration yourself.
